Looking at this question about Iranian cannabis populations and their genetic differentiation (FST) parameters, I need to consider which geographical regions in Iran show the greatest genetic divergence.

In studies of Iranian cannabis (Cannabis sativa) genetic structure, populations from the East/Southeast regions and the Northeast regions of Iran tend to show the greatest FST values. This is due to the significant geographical distance between these regions, along with different environmental pressures (arid vs. semi-arid climates, altitude differences, etc.), which drive greater genetic divergence.

The East/Southeast to Northeast pairing represents the most geographically distant and environmentally contrasting populations among the options, leading to the highest FST values.

[ANSWER]E[/ANSWER]
